title: STARTEX — Tuesday Morning, Spring Break on the Marlow Coast

fields.location: Marlow County Emergency Operations Center, Kellerton, Marlow County, Oregon
fields.weather: Overcast, light rain, 52°F. West wind 10 mph. Tide falling.
fields.load: High: about 3,800 spring-break visitors inside the tsunami zone; Cape Marlow State Park campground near capacity
fields.staffing: EOC in normal monitoring status with Director, Warning Coordinator and PIO on site; 911 fully staffed at the Port Alder primary center
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise, exercise, exercise. It is 10:00 AM Pacific Daylight Time on Tuesday, April 13, 2027, the middle of spring break on the Marlow County coast, with overcast skies, light rain, 52 degrees, a west wind at 10 miles per hour and a falling tide. The Emergency Operations Center in Kellerton is in normal monitoring status: Director Gwen Halvorsen is at her desk, Tsunami and Warning Coordinator Priya Natarajan is reviewing the siren battery report, and PIO Dale Whitcomb is drafting a spring-break beach safety post. About 3,800 visitors are inside the tsunami zone on the Port Alder waterfront, the Front Street shops, the Alder River mobile home park and the Cape Marlow State Park campground; Marlow Coast Community Hospital has 18 inpatients, Port Alder Elementary has 210 students at its spring-break day camp, and all systems are normal.

status.name: Marlow County EOC (Kellerton)
status.note: Normal monitoring status. Director, Warning Coordinator and PIO on site.

status.name: Marlow County Communications (911)
status.note: Fully staffed at the Port Alder primary center. Backup center at the EOC is idle.

status.name: Cape Marlow PUD power
status.note: No outages reported. Substations 1, 2 and 3 normal.

status.name: Tsunami sirens
status.note: All sites reporting. Battery report under routine review by the Warning Coordinator.

status.name: Port Alder Elementary
status.note: Spring-break day camp in session, 210 students.

status.name: Highway 101 and Highway 6
status.note: Open. Holiday traffic on the Alder River bridge and the Neskin grade.

fields.facilitatorNote: Before you read the card, check that every role has the EOP tsunami annex, the STWE and SOP-EQ-02 at its table, and that phone and radio channels are written down. Do not hint at what comes next. Play stays in normal monitoring until the next card.
fields.scenarioTitle: The Second Wave — Cascadia Rupture, Tsunami Evacuation & Message Discipline

instructorNote: This card sets the baseline only. Each role should confirm its position, its phone and radio channels, and where its plan references are (EOP, STWE, SOP-EQ-02). No other action is expected. Note who already knows the evacuation trigger for the hospital and the school.
